cohort: The study included 84 neonates born to mothers with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and 118 neonates born to mothers with uncomplicated pregnancies (control group).
finding: Neonates born to mothers with GDM demonstrate prolonged collagen with epinephrine (COL/EPI) closure times, indicating a more hyporesponsive platelet phenotype compared to neonates from uncomplicated pregnancies.
mod_finding: Higher COL/ADP CTs were demonstrated in neonates born via cesarean section.
gest_age: Measured and found to be negatively correlated with COL/ADP CT in neonates from the GDM group.
